{{Quote|I used to be military, then a diplomat. But not anymore. Now, I represent a group of loyal citizens, willing to go to any length to protect the true Republic from its enemies.|Spirakris Zarem|<ref name="SWTORTPOD" />}}
'''Spirakris Zarem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] page. She represented a group of individuals who supported their ideal of the [[True Republic]] during [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I was raised there. My father was an admiral and my mother was a Senator, but they were both killed during the war.|Zarem, talking about the Senate Building|<ref name="SWTORTPOD" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Spirakris Zarem was born to an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Spirakris Zarem's father|father]] and a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Spirakris Zarem's mother|mother]], living on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and growing up in and around the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. Orphaned during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Zarem joined the [[Republic Army]], eventually leaving that career to begin work as a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Zarem began work independently, joining a group of individuals that supported an ideal they called the [[True Republic]]. Believing the Galactic Republic could only be strong when it was allied with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and resolutely opposed the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Zarem worked on Coruscant to ensure that the group's goals were met.<ref name="SWTORTPOD" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
As the Cold War dragged on, some members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] grew weary of the stalemate. While milling around the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza's]] taxi pad, Zarem discovered a plot by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Glearius Parvil]] to introduce legislation that would break the Republic's ties with the Jedi Order and instead offer alliance to the Sith Empire. In order to prevent this, Zarem commissioned an independent agent to enter the Senate Building, sabotage the Senator's courier [[Droid/Legends|droid]], and steal a particular parcel that would serve as evidence against him. Because she was on [[Senate Security Officer|Senate Security]]'s watch list, she could not enter the building herself. However, her agent was persuaded that stealing the package was undemocratic, and delivered a parcel of outdated agricultural documents to her instead.<ref name="SWTORTPOD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Spirakris Zarem appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' Coruscant quest called "The Politics of Dissent". The player can also choose to turn the real parcel over to Zarem. This article assumes the player made the light side choice.
